task.title: 设备售后服务与巡检协同系统（综合业务案例）

outcome.detail: 已保存 Handoff，执行链仍在继续；不是终态。

checks.criterion: 主管创建客户与设备，刷新后关联正确；重复设备编号、必填缺失、报修时客户设备不匹配均被拒绝。未登录者不能读取或写入业务。
普通和紧急工单各受理一次，Workflow 执行记录、对应分支说明及业务结果一致；重复受理无重复结果或通知。在测试准备提供的可控失败条件下，记录失败及恢复结果；没有该条件时仅此失败场景记未执行。
负责人开始处理、填写说明、提交确认，主管退回一次，再次提交并关闭；非法跳步和空处理说明被拒绝，已关闭只读。刷新和重新登录后状态及结果保留。
上传 PNG 和 DOCX 并保存，刷新后分别预览真实内容；一次表单校验失败保留上传选择，移除关联后不再显示。无工单权限账号通过附件链接被拒绝，损坏文件给出真实失败提示。
受理、提交确认和退回的收件人收到对应持久消息，可跳至正确工单；标记已读刷新仍保持，非收件人不能读取。无权工单链接不能因消息而绕过权限。
有阅读资格的工程师可读已发布知识但不能读草稿或修改；没有阅读资格的账号不能仅因已发布而访问。不得用管理员账户代替这组验证。
甲乙工程师只能处理自己工单；普通工单临时共享给乙后乙仅可读该单及必要关联资料，撤销后不能再读；保密工单即使被分享也不能向非负责人开放。观察员看不到内部处理备注，主管和负责人正常访问。
主管与工程师的统计分别与各自可见列表一致；修改工单状态后数字更新，搜索和筛选不扩大权限范围。
用受控 Scheduler 执行生成到期设备巡检和超期提醒，重复执行不重复生成同日结果，未到期/停用设备及已关闭工单不被处理；计划启停保存正确，停用后的受控调度机会不再产生新结果。负责人完成巡检并刷新核对。
通过既有管理入口创建并撤销集成用户密钥；独立 HTTP 测试验证报修、状态查询、重复事件去重和禁止处理/关闭，撤销或停用后调用失败。密钥全程去敏。
主管上传两份手册，页面显示真实处理状态，普通工程师不能修改库内容。条件可用时，助手能回答一条有依据问题并提供引用，对资料外问题说明不足，对无权工单拒绝泄漏；更新手册后新对话依据新内容。缺外部条件时分别报告接入完成度与真实检索/回答未验证。

助手建议进入草稿，取消不写入、明确确认后才按用户权限保存，不能自动关闭；刷新可恢复对话。模型不可用时提示真实情况，手工处理仍可用。基础业务页面切换中英文后主要文案正确，录入内容不被翻译或丢失。

实际失败记 failed，缺条件记 blocked，未执行记 not_run；不得以源码存在、已提交或静态截图冒充实际业务完成。AI 条件不足不停止其他业务搭建，也不宣称综合验收全部通过。

processNotes.author: implementer
processNotes.summary: Built the equipment after-sales service and inspection collaboration system as application-owned NocoBase 3 source: 7 immutable migrations, 4 idempotent seeds, a ServiceDomainProvider service, an /api/service Hono route surface, one source-managed acceptance Workflow, 11 client pages/routes, bilingual strings, and business tests. Repair round 1: the production dist was not loadable because server/providers/service-domain.ts imported SERVICE_DOMAIN_SERVICE_KEY from the workflow package contract; moved the key into server/service/constants.ts so the compiled provider no longer reaches into the materialized Workflow Artifact. Repair round 2 fixed the observed browser-acceptance defects: the work-order detail route was unreachable because the child path was declared absolute under a parent (doubling the segment) and the parent never rendered Outlet; a new work order was auto-accepted instead of waiting for a supervisor and the list had no accept entry; a duplicate device serial surfaced as a raw 500 instead of a readable 409; a work order could bind a device to a different customer than its owner; required-field failures only showed a toast; identity Selects showed numeric ids; the header had no message center; and the integration entry pointed its API-key link at a dead path and lacked the page/device grants behind it; and the reachable detail page would have exposed internal handling remarks to an observer; the attachment area offered only a download link, with no way to preview the real PNG and DOCX content, and an uploaded file's claimed type was never checked against its bytes. Server behavior is now covered by tests/logic/service-domain.test.ts (13 passing) and the shell/routes/locale coverage tests still pass. Repair round 3: the header message bell assumed app.services is always present, so the three layout-i18n shell tests crashed on a minimal ClientApplication mock with Cannot read properties of undefined (reading has); the bell now guards the service lookup with optional chaining and stays hidden where the notification-in-app runtime is absent.

blockers.title: Production dist could not start: the service provider imported the workflow package contract
blockers.symptom: pnpm build completed and wrote dist/server/standalone.js, but nocobase start printed 'Missing dist/server/standalone.js. Run pnpm build first.' and exited 1, so browser acceptance never began.
blockers.rootCause: server/providers/service-domain.ts imported SERVICE_DOMAIN_SERVICE_KEY from ../workflows/work-order-acceptance/contract.js. The workflow plugin's afterServerBuild step removes dist/server/workflows and writes only hash-named Artifact directories, so the tsc-emitted dist/server/workflows/work-order-acceptance/contract.js no longer existed and the compiled provider failed to resolve it. The app-cli start script catches any ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND from importing dist/server/standalone.js and always reports the standalone file as missing, which hid the real nested missing module.
blockers.resolution: Moved the canonical SERVICE_DOMAIN_SERVICE_KEY into server/service/constants.ts and import it there from server/providers/service-domain.ts. Left server/workflows/work-order-acceptance/contract.ts self-contained with its own identical literal (its Run module is loaded from inside the materialized Artifact, where an import leaving the package does not resolve), with a comment tying the two values together. pnpm build succeeds, importing dist/server/standalone.js resolves, pnpm start reaches 'App server listening', and tests/logic/service-domain.test.ts passes including the acceptance Workflow run node.

blockers.title: Work-order detail was unreachable and the list had no accept/process entry
blockers.symptom: Clicking a work-order number changed the URL to /main (Home); /main/service/work-orders/1 redirected to /main; the duplicated child route /main/service/work-orders/service/work-orders/1 rendered only the list. The list rows had no accept/process control, so acceptance and every later lifecycle step could not be performed.
blockers.rootCause: client/routes.ts declared the child path as '/service/work-orders/:id' while the parent already contributed '/service/work-orders', producing the doubled segment; and client/pages/service/work-orders/index.tsx never rendered an <Outlet/>, so the matched child had nowhere to mount even when the path matched.
blockers.resolution: Changed the child path to ':id' (relative), rendered <Outlet/> at the end of the list PageContainer, and converted the detail page to <RouteChildPage><PageContainer/></RouteChildPage> with <Breadcrumbs/> instead of a manual 'back to list' link. Added breadcrumb titles on both routes (service.workOrders.title / service.workOrders.detailTitle). Row links are now relative with the current search preserved, and rows gained an inline supervisor Accept button plus an Open link so the first lifecycle step no longer depends on the detail page. Covered by tests/logic/client-routes.test.ts and the shell/route-navigation tests.

blockers.title: A new work order was accepted automatically instead of waiting for a supervisor
blockers.symptom: A work order created through New work order appeared directly as 'Ready to process' (待处理) instead of 待受理, so the supervisor acceptance step and its normal/urgent branch never ran against a pending order.
blockers.rootCause: createWorkOrder called acceptWorkOrder(auto:true) and triggerAcceptanceWorkflow itself, so acceptance happened inside creation rather than as an explicit supervisor action.
blockers.resolution: createWorkOrder now returns the order in 待受理 and only logs the creation activity. applyTransition('accept') performs the acceptance: it calls acceptWorkOrder(orderId, userId, {auto:false}) directly (assigning the engineer and notifying them through the idempotency key work-order:<id>:accepted) and then triggers the acceptance Workflow so its run/step/branch remains inspectable. A replayed accept is refused by the state machine (409) without a second notification. tests/logic/service-domain.test.ts now asserts pending_accept on creation, pending_process and dispatchCount 1 after acceptance, and dispatchCount still 1 after a replayed accept.

blockers.title: A duplicate device serial number returned 500 instead of a readable 409
blockers.symptom: Saving a device with an existing serial number showed 'Internal Server Error'; POST /api/service/devices returned 500 three times rather than a readable uniqueness rejection.
blockers.rootCause: saveDevice let the database unique constraint fail through to the route error handler. @nocobase/db exports its isUniqueConstraintViolation helper only from a non-public deep path, so the provider had no supported way to translate the raw violation into a domain error.
blockers.resolution: saveDevice now pre-checks for an existing device with the same serial number and a different id and throws ServiceDomainError('DEVICE_SERIAL_DUPLICATE', ..., 409); it also wraps create/update in a local isUniqueViolation(error) check (walking cause/originalError and matching errCode -6602, SQLSTATE 23505, ER_DUP_ENTRY, and the SQLite/MySQL/MSSQL constraint codes) that converts a raced violation into the same 409. The route's onError returns {code, message} as JSON. tests/logic/service-domain.test.ts asserts the 409 code and message.

blockers.title: A work order could attach a device to a different customer
blockers.symptom: POST /api/service/work-orders with {customerId:4, deviceId:5} returned 201 and created WO-20260928-0001 even though device 5 belongs to customer 3, silently detaching the device from its owner.
blockers.rootCause: createWorkOrder accepted an explicit customerId without checking it against the selected device's customerId.
blockers.resolution: createWorkOrder now refuses a mismatch with ServiceDomainError('CUSTOMER_DEVICE_MISMATCH', ..., 409) before deriving the effective customer. tests/logic/service-domain.test.ts asserts the 409 code/message for a mismatch and a 201 for the matching pair, so the check is not over-broad.

blockers.title: Required-field failures showed only a toast, and identity Selects showed numeric ids
blockers.symptom: With a required device field empty, Save sent no POST and left the dialog open, but there was no visible required-field text in the dialog. Customer/device Selects displayed the stored numeric id (e.g. 4) instead of the customer or device name.
blockers.rootCause: Client validation reported failures only through useToaster(), and Selects were rendered from <SelectItem> children without the Base UI `items` value-to-label map that SelectValue needs to render the selected option.
blockers.resolution:
Device, customer, work-order-create and integration forms now keep field-level error state and render an aria-invalid control plus a visible

message beside the field (server failures land in the same dialog and as a toast). Every identity-backed Select now receives an items array of {value,label}, which Base UI resolves for the trigger. Verified by typecheck and the route/shell tests; the inline rendering itself is a browser-acceptance item.

blockers.title: The header had no message center entry or page
blockers.symptom: The top bar had no message/notification button, the account menu only had Language and Sign out, and no page in the app searched to message/消息/notification/通知, so durable in-app messages were not reachable.
blockers.rootCause: The application registered the notification-in-app plugin but never exposed its inbox: no route, no navigation entry, and no header control.
blockers.resolution: Added the /service/messages route (auth required, authz skip because the inbox is per-actor) rendering PageContainer > NotificationInAppProvider > NotificationInAppInbox, and a MessageBell in header-actions that wraps the provider, links to the inbox, and shows the provider's unread count. The bell hides itself when the notification-in-app runtime service is absent, so the application shell does not depend on the plugin's service in a minimal context. Messages now resolve once and navigate to the real inbox.

blockers.title: The integration user could not reach API-key management or list devices
blockers.symptom: Device integration's 'Manage API keys' link pointed at /main/api-keys and fell back to Home; /main/settings/api-keys showed 'No settings available' for the integration user. GET /main/api/service/devices returned 403, so the integration report form's Device dropdown was empty and the form could not be submitted.
blockers.rootCause: The link used a path that is not a route (the API Keys plugin mounts its page at /settings/api-keys), and the integration permission set lacked page('api-keys') access and serviceDevices view, so the settings tree and device list were both filtered out.
blockers.resolution: The page now links to /settings/api-keys. The integration permission set gains page('api-keys') access and serviceDevices view (reference-scoped), and database/main/seeds/202609260002_service_permissions.ts reconciles the stored integration grants against the code definition so an upgraded application picks the change up without touching other sets' admin edits.

blockers.title: Overdue reminders counted notifications that had no valid recipient
blockers.symptom: sendOverdueReminders reported one more reminder than notification_dispatches rows: one dispatch failed with 'In-app to must contain application user IDs.' while still incrementing the sent count.
blockers.rootCause: An order created for a device without a service engineer stored assigneeId as '' rather than NULL: asText(null) returns '' and the ?? null normalization treats '' as present. sendOverdueReminders then treated '' as a real recipient and attempted a notification.
blockers.resolution: Identity columns are now normalized through optionalString so a null/empty engineerId leaves assigneeId null in createWorkOrder, acceptWorkOrder and defaultAssigneeFor, and sendOverdueReminders skips an order whose assignee is absent or empty. tests/logic/service-domain.test.ts verifies sent === dispatchCount for the day.

blockers.title: An observer could read internal handling remarks on an order timeline
blockers.symptom: Once the work-order detail route became reachable, an observer opening a permitted non-confidential order received the full activity timeline, including the free-text remarks staff add through the comment action, which the read-only role must not see.
blockers.rootCause: orderDetail returned every serviceWorkOrderActivities row for anyone who could read the order, without separating the internal handling note (ACTIVITY_ACTIONS.commented) from the status history.
blockers.resolution: orderDetail now omits commented activities for the observer and the external integration roles, while the supervisor and the assigned engineer keep the full timeline. tests/logic/service-domain.test.ts adds a case that posts an internal remark, confirms the supervisor sees it, and confirms the observer does not.

blockers.title: Attachments could not be previewed and a corrupted file was stored without a real failure
blockers.symptom: The work-order detail attachment area listed files with a download link only. A PNG showed a thumbnail, but a DOCX had no preview, so the acceptance requirement to preview the real content of both formats could not be met. A file whose bytes did not match its claimed type was stored anyway, so a corrupted file produced no real failure.
blockers.rootCause: The detail page never used the preinstalled application-owned FilePreviewDialog, and the upload route validated only the declared extension and MIME type, never the content signature. The order detail also returned bare attachment link rows without the stored file metadata a preview needs.
blockers.resolution: orderDetail now joins filename/ext/mimeType/size onto each attachment, the detail page maps them to FileRecord objects, shows an in-progress indicator while an upload runs, and renders a Preview action through FilePreviewDialog from client/extensions/nocobase-file-component-ui (the OOXML viewer renders DOCX). The upload route rejects a file whose bytes are not a PNG signature or a ZIP/OOXML container with a 415 INVALID_FILE_CONTENT. tests/logic/service-domain.test.ts asserts the returned file metadata and both corrupted-file refusals.

blockers.title: Reported observer visibility of a confidential work order did not reproduce
blockers.symptom: The browser acceptance observed the observer account's work-order list showing all rows and identified the confidential WO-2026-0005 (Confidential) as visible, which would mean the observer read scope leaked an internal order.
blockers.rootCause: readableOrderIds already returns only rows whose confidential flag is falsy for a pure observer, and the observer account is assigned only the service-observer permission set in the seeded database. The observed seven rows equal the five non-confidential seed orders plus the two QA-created non-confidential orders, so WO-2026-0005 was not actually in the observer's list.
blockers.resolution: No code change. Confirmed against the seeded database (observer holds only service-observer and WO-2026-0005 has confidential=1) and by tests/logic/service-domain.test.ts, which asserts the observer list contains no confidential order while the supervisor list does, so the check is not vacuous. The same non-disclosure is asserted for the order detail and for sharing a confidential order.

blockers.title: Real-browser rendering of the service pages is not exercised by the agent
blockers.symptom: No Playwright/Chromium is available in the repair environment, so the service pages were never rendered in a real browser.
blockers.rootCause: Environment limitation, not an application defect.
blockers.resolution: Proxies used: the client-routes test imports every page module in jsdom, the shell/route-navigation tests render the application layout, and typecheck covers the client/server/node projects. Left for the factory's browser acceptance step to confirm.

blockers.title: The header message bell crashed the shell layout tests on a minimal app context
blockers.symptom: tests/components/layout-i18n.test.tsx failed all three shell-translation cases with TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading has) at client/layouts/components/message-bell.tsx:35, so the header, footer, tooltips and settings/dev page headers could not be asserted.
blockers.rootCause: MessageBell called app.services.has(realtimeClientToken) directly. The test builds a partial ClientApplication ({config, runtime}) without services, so the property was undefined and the guard threw instead of hiding the bell.
blockers.resolution: Changed the guard to app.services?.has(realtimeClientToken), so a context without a service resolver renders nothing as intended and the real application still checks the notification-in-app runtime. Ran vitest on tests/components/layout-i18n.test.tsx (5 passed) plus the other header-action consumers tests/components/app-layout-routes.test.tsx and tests/logic/client-settings.test.tsx (30 passed); eslint, prettier and tsc --noEmit pass for the change.

improvements.title: A nested module resolution failure is reported as a missing standalone entry
improvements.detail: The @nocobase/app-cli start script catches ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND from importing dist/server/standalone.js and unconditionally prints 'Missing dist/server/standalone.js. Run pnpm build first.', which names the entry file even when the missing module is a nested import inside the server graph. This sent the first repair pass at the build output instead of the import graph.
improvements.suggestedChange: In @nocobase/app-cli start.mjs, check that the standalone entry itself exists before importing, and let a nested ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND surface the original missing specifier instead of rewriting it to the standalone-file message.

improvements.title: Nullable identity columns coerce to empty strings through a text helper
improvements.detail: asText(value, fallback = '') returns '' for null, and call sites that combine it with `?? null` keep the empty string because ?? only replaces null/undefined. The result is stored as an empty-string identifier or notification recipient, which is neither a valid id nor absent, and only surfaces later as a rejected notification or a broken filter.
improvements.suggestedChange: Normalize optional identity values through a single helper that maps null, undefined and empty/whitespace strings to null (or undefined) before writing, and use it for every foreign-key and assignee column.
